principles: Know what is coming in and going out each month, even if it is rough.
Early on, build the habit of saving something, however small.
Ask about student and young person discounts before you buy.

gentle.title: Building your first buffer
gentle.body: If you are a student or early in your career, a first buffer matters more than a big one. Yours covers about {emergency_fund_months} months of essentials at {essential_monthly_spend} a month, and each small top-up helps.

blunt.title: Grow your first buffer
blunt.body: Your savings cover {emergency_fund_months} months of essentials at {essential_monthly_spend} a month. Whether you are studying or just starting work, add to it every month, even if the amount is small.
